response.sql: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS exam_count FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), stats AS (SELECT SUM(exam_count) AS total_count, AVG(exam_count * 1.0) AS avg_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.exam_count) AS total_counts, AVG(sc.exam_count * 1.0 / s.total_count) AS avg_share, AVG(sc.exam_count - s.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM sex_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE sc.exam_count > s.avg_count
